## About
Mac’s Auto Body is a family owned and operated full service auto body shop on Russell Street in Somerville, a short walk from the Davis Square Red Line T stop. David Medeiros is the current owner, and customer satisfaction is our number one priority.
We are collision repair specialists. Our technicians restore your vehicle to its pre-accident condition, and we work with all insurance companies so the claim side is one less thing for you to handle. Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 119 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: We are collision repair specialists, focused on quality repairs that get you safely back on the road.
- Insurance repairs: We work with all insurance companies for your collision repair.
- Scratches: One reviewer had scratches on their car they wanted fixed, and said David, the owner, was super transparent about everything.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies for your collision repair.

Q: Can I get a free estimate?
A: Yes. Call or stop by the shop to get a free estimate.

Q: When are you open?
A: We are open 8 AM to 5 PM, Monday through Friday.
